Enforce scheduled GitHub server allowlist for v2/v3

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-7
  description: |-
    Intersect live catalog-derived scheduled tools with SCHEDULED_GITHUB_READ_TOOLS and SCHEDULED_GITHUB_WRITE_TOOLS during materialization and MCP preflight so forged or stale leases cannot expose unapproved non-destructive write tools.
    
    Add github_scheduled_tools_for_access and is_scheduled_github_server_tool helpers, a regression test for dispatch_workflow rejection, and reconcile the normative scheduled-authorization plan with the implemented v3 contract.
